snippet.title: Zoo Wars - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Launch animals from your zoo and destroy your opponent’s zoo! A simple yet deep online real-time tower defense game built around 6-card decks. Send animals from your zoo and take down your opponent’s zoo! Zoo Wars is a
real-time PvP tower defense game where cute animals and fruits clash in fast-paced battles. Build a deck from 6 animal and fruit cards, deploy units in real time, and be the first to destroy your opponent’s zoo to win.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3989360/Zoo_Wars/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
